blurb: Guests embark on boat tours from Crescent Beach Marina to see whales and other wildlife in their natural habitat across the Strait of Georgia. Trips typically last between three to five hours and include visits to the Canadian Gulf Islands and US San Juan Islands. Private charters and specialized tours such as winery visits, pub lunches, sunset cruises, and sea lion tours are also offered.
extraNote: Trips are weather-dependent; operator may postpone trips or change boats due to weather or mechanical problems · Trips are not refundable · Crescent Beach Marina, 12555 Crescent Road, Surrey, BC, Canada
